_comment: The stamped LINKED tier: how many matched translation units actually reach the
PC port's binary. This is a STAMP, not a live counter, and it cannot be anything
else from main: port/tools/linkage.py reads build/port/walk_window.map, which only
exists after an MSVC build of the port, and CI on main has no such build.
BEFORE STAMPING, LOOK FOR A BUILD THAT ALREADY EXISTS. Every port lane carries its
own build tree, so a current walk_window.map is usually already on disk:
ls -la */build/port/walk_window.map
across the port worktrees, newest first, then run the tool against that root. The
first version of this file was stamped off a five-day-old branch while a map from
the night before sat unread one directory away, and published 26.5% when the real
figure was 34.5%. A stale stamp is still a real measurement, just of the wrong run.
To refresh: run `python port/tools/linkage.py [root]` and update the numbers below
together with branch, commit and measuredAt. Never move the count without also
moving the provenance fields - tools/tiers.py drops a stamp missing any of them,
which is the intended behaviour for a number nobody can trace.
basis records what the figure is a measurement OF. The port branches are not merged,
so this is the best single lane rather than a combined total. All seven live lanes,
lk5 3819. Overlapping but not identical seats, so the merged figure is higher and
the published number stays a floor.
LINKED grows when matched TUs become reachable in the port's linked call graph.
Actor methods and free functions both count. Enrollment alone does not increase
the count when the release build still dead-strips the unreachable object.
basis: integration branch port/link100 at its pushed tip 597e584fc, measured against that tip's own battery build walk_window.map (C:/tmp/l1-int, gate INT28: tree clean, reconfigure with the four hostgen register TUs, battery ALL GREEN at floor 10503 with all 51 level and 37 scene rows including the Game Over scene, the six proofs, the loopback pair with the ROM's own wireless worker created, entered, slept and woken on the parent, the four-player proof, the rollback ladder at eight wide with every session row green including seven windows at 160 ms, and a captured level under the ROM's own frame loop), and confirmed by the hosted-runner port-linkage workflow on every push of port/** and every pull request into the shipping branch. +18 over the previous stamp of 10503, +488 over the 2026-09-08 morning's 10033, +1400 over the 2026-08-30 stamp of 9121. Since the 10503 stamp: the wireless file system band hosted at the objects the ROM really addresses (a decimal misread had refused eleven bodies; +11), five more of the ROM's static initialisers as ROM bodies so 21 of the 24 table words are the cartridge's own (+7), and the ROM's own touch sampler as the single writer of the touch ring (0). AND THE FLIP: at this tip the ROM's own game loop is the shipped default frame driver for every level and scene (the host loop stays behind SM64DS_ROM_LOOP=0 for one release), with the loop made deterministic under a rollback re-simulation (a replayed frame takes no radio turn; the VBlank count advances once per frame wait) and the VS menu's last member-pointer dispatch seated as the ROM's own body; the level-1 selftest position is unchanged on both arms. Running: the ROM's own wake ending every solo frame and thread switches on interrupt return, the ARM7's port-receive indication, the decomp-side honesty of the matched count.
